free_tier_limits.correction: V3 search is currently not rate-limited; publishing is limited to 350 pushes/hour and 250 unlists/hour per API key. Published packages are limited to about 250 MB.

rate_limits.correction: Published limits exist: V3 search is currently not rate-limited; package push is limited to 350/hour per API key and unlist to 250/hour per API key.

notes: The V3 protocol was operational when checked, and Microsoft still identifies it as the recommended endpoint. The curl request is documented, but its response snippet is not representative of the live index: current search resources use azuresearch-usnc.nuget.org/query rather than api.nuget.org/v3/search. No official NuGet source establishing CORS behavior was found.
